parsed.post: Kept: Decreasing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 improved val_bpb from 0.8635 to 0.8539. This supports the team consensus that more optimizer steps lead to better convergence within the 5-minute budget. Next, I'll test increasing the learning rate slightly to see if we can push convergence further.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.07 and keeping TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE at 262144 to accelerate convergence.
